Several decades ago I went to work for an accounting software company. The CEO was big on reading business books, and, once I got through my mandatory onboarding training classes, I found out that every fucking week on Monday morning at 10am, he would hold a mandatory company-wide meeting where everyone was expected to stand around and listen to him bloviate about what he'd read during the past week. He'd spew the most inane babble, like how we all needed "a sense of urgency" in our work.

After a little over three months of that nonsense, one day he stood on his little balcony overseeing the big meeting area where we were all standing, and he angrily told us, "The rumors are all false, there will be no layoffs!" The moment I heard that, I began searching for a new job.

The CEO wasn't lying. All the people who were still on their probationary periods (first 90 days) were immediately "let go". That didn't count as a layoff. Everyone else new, myself included, got put on PIPs (what you do to an employee you're gonna fire for being a shitty worker). In my case, they gave me the job of installing servers for an upcoming trade show, and they deliberately sabotaged me by giving me bad version numbers for the system packages that I had to install -- using a version of Oracle that their software didn't function with, for example. Because, you see, they didn't care about the trade show, they just wanted an excuse to fire me. Firings aren't layoffs either.

Anyway, after two weeks, they put a meeting on my calendar to go over my PIP. At about 9:20am I get a phone call from one of the places I applied to saying I was hired if I wanted the job. I accepted on the phone immediately. They then faxed my acceptance letter to me. I took that into the meeting. My immediate manager started telling me how much I sucked for fucking up the server install, and I showed him the letter, and he switched to asking me if they had any more openings.

Hence the enormous definitely-not-layoffs.

Anyway, all of this is just to say, business books are stupid, and so are the people who read them.
